title: Effect of carrot and orange-fleshed sweet potato incorporation on the chemical and sensory characteristics of acha–peanut extrudates
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00798D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Stephen Sule, Mike Ojotu Eke, Victor Bajo Sale
Incorporation of peanut meal, carrot, and OFSP into acha improved nutritional quality, digestibility, and sensory acceptability of extruded snacks. The APC blend showed superior mineral content, β-carotene, and overall consumer preference.
